not_covered: General cloud or AVM compliance certification

security_reporting.rule: Follow the official private reporting route for sensitive unsafe guidance/credential exposure; do not disclose secrets, account identifiers or private configuration in public GitHub issues. No report to upstream was filed by this audit.

integrity_method.local_raw_file_algorithm: SHA-256 and Git blob SHA-1: SHA1(blob + space + byte_length + NUL + file_bytes)
integrity_method.upstream_comparison: Compare local file Git blob IDs against complete immutable upstream recursive tree. Separately normalize CRLF->LF for Windows checkout transport differences; never call normalized match byte-identical.
integrity_method.initial_observation: All installed files differed from upstream raw blobs because of Windows checkout line endings. After CRLF normalization all but the two already locally corrected terraform-test files matched upstream.
integrity_method.post_repair_lock_behavior: Original install/source lock left untouched; upstream source-tree pins remain provenance, not hashes of locally repaired content. Current per-file SHA-256 snapshots record reviewed local overlays.
integrity_method.signature_and_malware_limits: No independent commit signature, binary attestation, full malicious-code proof or exhaustive reference semantic verification; absence of a static finding is not a safety guarantee.

required_gates.credentials: No credential values, credential stores, cloud profiles, login flows or secret-bearing environment dumps were inspected. Future use requires explicit approval for the exact identity/account/project/region and least-privilege auth; never print/store secrets in audit output.
required_gates.cost: No new cloud/HCP expense is authorized. Packer builds, real-provider Terraform tests, registry metadata and HCP RUM/paid features require separate explicit budget approval; not free merely because an operation is labelled test/metadata/plan.
required_gates.cloud_mutation: Do not run apply/import/query-triggered workflows, Packer build, action invoke, Stack upload/approval, DNS integration or other live mutations during this audit. A Stack configuration upload can trigger remote runs.
required_gates.destruction: No destroy, sweep, disappears tests, resource-group deletion guard relaxation, WinRM listener/cache cleanup or recursive deletion is authorized on user infrastructure/workstation. A future cleanup needs exact targets, account scope and explicit approval.
required_gates.dependency_execution: No new binary/hook/dependency installation or unpinned npx/go get/packer init/terraform init -upgrade is authorized. Review and pin executable provider/plugin/action dependencies before use; repo pin does not pin commands embedded in skills.
required_gates.project_execution: Skill/project commands are untrusted instructions until target code is reviewed. go generate, go test, provider schema, provisioners and even compilation init paths can execute arbitrary code. This assignment executes no project/cloud tests or generated payloads.
required_gates.network_read: Public primary-source documentation/catalog requests were allowed. Cloud inventory, provider refresh/schema acquisition, identity validation and HCP API reads can use credentials, disclose inventory or incur usage; separately approve before execution.
required_gates.state_write: No Terraform state mutation, backend migration or import/state mv is authorized. Protect state snapshots, confirm mapping and review an empty/expected plan before a separately approved real migration. Never log raw state.
required_gates.publication: No CI workflow enablement, Git tag/release, Registry/HCP metadata publication or artifact/image publishing is authorized by this static audit. Review labels/outputs for sensitive metadata.
required_gates.iam_change: No service-principal/credential creation, role grant, federation/trust policy change or branch-protection edit is authorized. The broad Contributor examples are not least-privilege approval.
required_gates.license_review: Repository default is MPL-2.0, but 16 .sentinel examples explicitly declare BUSL-1.1. Preserve file-level notices and review the applicable source license/terms before reuse or redistribution; no blanket all-MPL representation.
